name: Kite Maps
subtitle: A free, open-source maps app for iPhone.
description: The official source for Kite Maps, an unofficial iPhone port of Vela Maps.

apps.name: Kite Maps
apps.subtitle: Maps, search and turn-by-turn navigation.
apps.localizedDescription: Kite Maps is a free, open-source maps app: search places, get directions, voice navigation with speed cameras and lane guidance, transit, Street View and more. It's an unofficial iPhone port of Vela Maps by PimpinPumpkin.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 5. See what's new on GitHub: https://github.com/NotDiscordOfficial/kite-maps/releases/tag/v0.7.5-beta

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Kite searches your local network for compatible displays when you use receiver diagnostics.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kite keeps guiding you with the screen off during navigation.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kite shows where you are on the map, finds places near you and guides you turn by turn.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kite listens when you tap the microphone to search by voice.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kite turns what you say into a search.
